questions.q: What does Roza offer her son on Saturday night?
o: To go out somewhere with him
questions.e: In the video: "E, hoćeš možda da ja izađem s tobom?" — well, do you want me to go out with you?

questions.q: Why can't Milentije go out alone?
o: After half an hour he has to come back to Mum and her medicines
questions.e: In the video: "posle pola sata da se vraćam kući" — come back home after half an hour

questions.q: What does Roza read aloud?
questions.e: In the video: "Zovem se Dragoljubka" — my name is Dragoljubka

questions.q: How does Roza speak about Nina when she arrives?
questions.e: In the video: "A pa obožavam Ninu." — oh, I adore Nina.

questions.q: What did Roza use to say about Nina?
o: That she'd never been to the opera
questions.e: In the video: "da ima čukljeve i da nikad u životu nije bila u operi" — that she has bunions and has never been to the opera in her life

questions.q: How old is Nina's young man?
questions.e: In the video: "Osamnaest!" — Eighteen!

questions.q: Why is there no tea in the house?
questions.e: In the video: "Ali je izgorelo lonče." — but the little pot burned.

questions.q: What is the name of the babysitter Jovanka sends?
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam Bosa." — I'm Bosa.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Mnogi ljudi nemaju s kim da izađu *subotom* uveče.
questions.e: subotom — on Saturdays.

questions.q: Ili na *korzo* da prošetamo, opusti se.
questions.e: korzo — the evening promenade.

questions.q: Pa možemo i u *diskoteku*.
questions.e: diskoteka — disco.

questions.q: Starateljstvo.
questions.e: starateljstvo — guardianship.

questions.q: Ovo ima *pesnički* talenat, da.
questions.e: pesnički — poetic.

questions.q: Nisam *gladna*.
questions.e: gladan — hungry.

questions.q: U ovoj kući samo ja imam pravo da baratam *oštrim* predmetima.
questions.e: oštar — sharp.

questions.q: Pa to ti je *nesanica*.
questions.e: nesanica — insomnia.

questions.q: Hoćeš da ti čitam ___?
questions.e: Čitati + accusative: novine (plural).

questions.q: Imam to što je ostavila ___ sina.
questions.e: Animate masculine accusative: mog sina.

questions.q: Idem ja da skuvam čaj, a vi me čekajte u ___.
questions.e: «U» for a place takes the locative: u sobi.

questions.q: Ne znam da li je taj čaj dobar na ___ stomak.
questions.e: Inanimate masculine accusative: prazan stomak.

questions.q: Ja ću ti doneti iz ___ kolač.
questions.e: The preposition «iz» takes the genitive: iz restorana.

questions.q: Zato privedite taj razvod ___.
questions.e: Privesti kraju — to bring to an end (dative).

questions.q: Ne umem da ___.
questions.e: After «da» the present tense; 1st sg.: štrikam.

questions.q: Dobro veče, ___.
questions.e: The vocative of Rosa is Roso.
